positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Developed the integration between Grainger's next-gen MLOps Kubernetes clusters and Astronomer (managed Airflow) and managed the migration of 20+ teams from the MLOps team's self hosted Airflow.

positions.title: Data Science Engineer
positions.description: Part of a team that creates and manages data science solutions for both internal and external facing prognostic and health monitoring (PHM) products. In this role I have worked to promote software development best practices, assisted in the development of analytics for 787 fleets, and worked with analytic developers to deliver new analytic capabilities within our internally managed repository. In order to close the gap for the team's DevOps Engineering related needs, I oversee the deployment of all new analytics to our production environment, manage and make improvements to the CI/CD pipelines that delivers analytic results to our downstream products, and continue to seek ways to incorporate new best practices and tools into our solutions.

positions.title: Senior Engineer, Data Intelligence and AIOps
positions.description:
As a senior engineer at Collins, it's hard to classify myself as just a systems engineer, data engineer, DevOps/MLOps engineer, or even solutions architect because I simply have been doing it all. My most recent accomplishments include designing and developing the new framework and process through which all Ascentia analytics will be developed, tested, and productionized. This has resulted in a near 12x reduction in the time it takes to batch process all historic data and a near 25x reduction in the Databricks cost for computing analytic results by implementing more intelligent uses of Spark, Delta Tables, and the many features of Databricks. I am in the process of enabling teams across Collins and RTX to use this framework as a standardized way of rapidly producing meaningful and impactful analytics for the various data sources available.

As part of the Data Intelligence team within the Advanced Research and Technology business unit, I primarily support the Ascentia product from an enablement perspective and take those lessons learned in order to advance the rest of the organization towards smarter, more efficient decision making. In supporting the Ascentia Data Science team I have the following responsibilities:
- Manage all tools development for the Ascentia Data Science tools team (1 US, 2 India).
- Build, maintain, and improve development and production CI/CD pipelines for Ascentia analytics.
- Manage Databricks Workspace user permissions.
- Establish Databricks cluster policies and analyze workloads to improve resource utilization and efficiency across clusters.
- Manage and contribute to the Prognostics and Health Monitoring (PHM) Python repository.
- Communicate needs with relevant subject matter experts across functional teams to allow for better automation of processes and integration with the Ascentia application.
- Train teams on the usage of the Ascentia Data Science PHM framework and extensively document all work for ease of use.
positions.insights: Microsoft Azure, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +7 skills
